AcceptanceRequest.title: AcceptanceRequest
AcceptanceRequest.description: Exact delivery digest and optional human rejection feedback.

AnswerRequest.title: AnswerRequest
AnswerRequest.description: Human answers to the pending discovery questions.

ApprovalRequest.title: ApprovalRequest
ApprovalRequest.description: Exact blueprint digest; callers cannot supply their own approval identity.

Blueprint.title: Blueprint
Blueprint.description: Approved project inputs with complete, acyclic requirement traceability.

CheckSpec.title: CheckSpec
CheckSpec.description: A protected executable definition, independent of agent-written reports.

DeliverySpec.title: DeliverySpec
DeliverySpec.description: Approved documentation required in the actual integrated source before delivery.

DiscoveryRequest.title: DiscoveryRequest
DiscoveryRequest.description: Explicit human authorization for planning inference, without implementation approval.

FindingExceptionRequest.title: FindingExceptionRequest
FindingExceptionRequest.description: Explicit human justification bound to one immutable source revision.

ImportRequest.title: ImportRequest
ImportRequest.description: Human-submitted proposed blueprint, policy and local source path.

InferenceSpec.title: InferenceSpec
InferenceSpec.description: Approved model, isolated CLI image and measurable per-attempt inference limits.

Limits.title: Limits
Limits.description: Run bounds recorded with approval and enforced before dispatch.

Mode.title: Mode
Mode.description: Declare the requested enforcement guarantee without automatic downgrade.

Permissions.title: Permissions
Permissions.description: Explicit local effects; external release is separately authorized.

PlanningDocument.title: PlanningDocument
PlanningDocument.description: A bounded reviewable artifact whose path cannot overwrite factory authority.

Policy.title: Policy
Policy.description: A schema-versioned policy activated only through trusted administration.

Profile.title: Profile
Profile.description: Operator-selected local image and project-owned real verification commands.

Requirement.title: Requirement
Requirement.description: A scope item with an observable acceptance criterion.

RevisionRequest.title: RevisionRequest
RevisionRequest.description: A new proposed version that cannot inherit an earlier approval.

Role.title: Role
Role.description: Roles the trusted scheduler can assign to bounded agent attempts.

RoleConfiguration.title: RoleConfiguration
RoleConfiguration.description: An explicit model binding with a finite role identity and portable JSON schema.

TaskSpec.title: TaskSpec
TaskSpec.description: A requirement-linked assignment and declared component ownership.

UsageRequest.title: UsageRequest
UsageRequest.description: Human accounting values for an unknown inference charge, with an audit reference.
